plan.notes: Source: Erie Community College (SUNY Erie) official catalog, 'Program: Business: Business Administration, A.A.S.' (Associate in Applied Science, HEGIS 5004, Curriculum Code 632.BUS), Curriculum section with term-by-term layout 'First Year, Fall Semester' through 'Second Year, Spring Semester' plus the catalog note 'This is a recommended sequence' (catalog.ecc.edu). Four semesters transcribed exactly as published. Published total degree credits: 62-64 (range, because the SUNY Gen Ed Mathematics Elective and Natural Sciences Elective are each 3 or 4 credits); both transcribed at 3 credits, giving semester sums 16+16+15+15 = 62 = total_credits (the sequence's own total at minimum elective credits; the 62-64 range is documented here). Prerequisite ordering verified: BU 121 Accounting Principles I (Fall 1) before BU 122 Accounting Principles II (Spring 1); EN 100 before EN 101/EN 102. Published choice slots: EN 101 (Composition for the Humanities) OR EN 102 (Composition for the STEM Disciplines); SUNY Gen Ed Mathematics Elective (3 or 4); SUNY Gen Ed Natural Sciences Elective (3 or 4); four Business Elective slots (recommended emphasis lists published: Accounting — BU 221/225/226; Management/Marketing — BU 251/252/253/254/255; Supervisory Skills — BU 231/232/233/234/241/242/243/244/247/248/262; interdisciplinary selection permitted). Degree classification: AAS = career-oriented associate (workforce-focused per NYSED/AAS norms), though the catalog notes the program also supports transfer via articulation agreements. Erie Community College is the SUNY community college serving Erie County (City/North/South campuses, Buffalo area).
